passages.selected_text: D_SWEEP: Democratic House and Democratic Senate (most likely)

Our own dossier got the direction wrong for risk assets. DOS §6.1 mapped a Democratic sweep to US500 down, USTEC down and BTC down, following strategists (Hartnett, Yardeni). The sweep came, and those markets rose. The gold-up and USD-down legs were right.
Jim's question: when did each market move on 4 Nov?

passages.selected_text: "Only in the US session" holds for Bitcoin's breakout and oil's slide. It does not hold for gold, silver and US500. Gold moved at noon Vietnam time, as the Senate calls came in. US500 turned at 11:00 and climbed all through Asia and Europe.
